claims.statement: On a centered minimum-dimensional F/J critical core with rho>4, every relative-1/16 robust row i has a physical trigger k_i with c_{k_i<-i}<7 q_i/44, h_{k_i i}>63 q_i/44, and (4+j'(q_{k_i})) h_{k_i i}>9 q_i.
claims.scope: genuine ratio-critical core; relative-1/16 robust rows only

claims.statement: Choosing one low-crossing physical trigger per robust row and deleting the minimum-q tail from each directed cycle produces a forest T retaining Q_* >= Q_R/2. Its selected support-hidden bank satisfies H_T>9 Q_* >= (9/2)Q_R and H_T<=2(4+2/ln2)J.
claims.scope: same critical-core robust-row scope; original physical coordinates only

claims.statement: For the selected physical forest T, the exact spectral identity sum_{e in T} r_e = sum_{v in V(T)} q_v - E[kappa_T(X)] implies O_T <= 4(4+2/ln2)J. Thus opposite-sign overlap is paid once and the negative component credit is retained.
claims.scope: all finite Boolean sources for any physical forest; applied here to the selected critical-core forest

claims.statement: The exact selected hidden ledger U_T^sel=sum w_k[p_{ki}-2c_{k<-i}+4o_{ki}] is dimension-freely bounded by 6(4+2/ln2)J, while its support-hidden part remains > (9/2)Q_R.
claims.scope: selected robust-pair forest, not raw H4 or U4

claims.statement: On the exact phi_6 tensor family, cross-factor pairs have p=c=h=0 and cannot be robust trigger edges; on the one-point surgery family the original codimension-five row supports remain relative-1/16 robust and the selector continues to use factor-local triggers. Any cross-factor forest has O_T=O(J) and surgery support-hidden contribution o(J), so the raw-U4 divergence mechanism does not survive nonreused forest selection.
claims.scope: the source tensor and one-point-surgery families; mechanism stress test, not a claim that these are rho>4 critical cores

consumed_peer_artifact.application: Used h_{ki}=p_{ki}-2c_{k<-i} and the proof-scoped separation of support-hidden H4 from opposite-sign O4, then replaced aggregate all-pair spending by an explicit cycle-broken physical forest.

remaining_implication: Use the selected forest support-hidden endpoint mass H_T>(9/2)Q_R to obtain one affordable physical restriction/block contradiction to rho>4, or prove Q_R universally small and transfer to the nonrobust-row branch. Do not return to raw H4/U4 payment.
